sources.entry: Nirvati - Easily 1-click spin up popular self-hosted apps from a convenient web interface. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Rust/K8S

summary.name: Nirvati
summary.one_liner: Nirvati is a self-hosted app platform that lets you spin up popular self-hosted apps with one click from a web interface, and this GitLab page is the backend repository.
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository view for the Nirvati backend. It shows a Git revision selector listing the main branch and about 20 tags, including v0.10.0 alpha, beta, release candidate and dev builds, plus v0.9.15. A code owners section is present but empty. Per the awesome-selfhosted listing quoted on the page, Nirvati lets you 1-click spin up popular self-hosted apps from a web interface, is written in Rust, targets Kubernetes, and is licensed AGPL-3.0. The page text itself contains little beyond repository navigation.
notable: Written in Rust with Kubernetes (K8S) as the target platform
One-click installation of popular self-hosted apps via a web interface
Many pre-release tags (alpha, beta, rc, dev) on v0.10.0
caveats: The page is only a repository view; no installation or usage documentation is shown
Several listed v0.10.0 versions are alpha, beta, or release candidate builds
